# CheckNumber WhatsApp API family

Official examples for three asynchronous, file-based CheckNumber products. Base URL: https://api.checknumber.ai. Authentication: `X-API-Key`.

## Workflow

1. `POST /v1/tasks` as multipart form data with `file` and `task_type`.
2. `POST /v1/gettasks` with `task_id` until `status=exported` or `failed`.
3. Download `result_url` only after export.

Input is a text file with one E.164 phone number per line.

## Products

- `ws`: 500–10,000,000 rows; fields `number`, `activated`.
- `ws_active`: 1,000–10,000,000 rows; fields `number`, `activated`, `activetime`, `activedays`, `business`. The retired `signature` field is not returned.
- `ws_avatar`: 500–10,000,000 rows; fields `number`, `activated`, `age`, `avatar`, `category`, `gender`, `hair_color`, `skin_color`. There is one canonical `number` column.

## Resources

- Documentation: https://docs.checknumber.ai/whatsapp-bulk-checker
- API keys: https://platform.checknumber.ai
- Pricing: https://checknumber.ai/pricing
- Landing page: https://checknumber.ai/products/whatsapp

Never expose an API key in browser-side production code. The repository contains Python, Node.js, Go, Java, C#, PHP, browser JavaScript, and Shell examples.
